chunks.text: If you need a checkup, have a toothache, or need dental treatment, this episode will help you.
I will teach you useful words, common phrases, and important questions that you may need at the dentist.
Going to the dentist can be a little scary or confusing if you don't speak English very well.
But don't worry.
After this episode, you will be more confident when talking to the dentist or the dental assistant.
Common words at the dentist's office.
First, let's learn some important words that you will hear at the dentist.
I will say each word slowly, and you can repeat after me.
Types of people at the dentist's office.
Dentist, a doctor who takes care of your teeth.
Dental hygienist, a person who cleans your teeth and helps the dentist.
Dental assistant, a person who helps the dentist and hygienist during procedures.
Patient, a person who goes to the dentist for treatment.
Types of dental treatments.
Checkup, a visit to the dentist to check the health of your teeth.
Cleaning, the process of cleaning your teeth to remove plaque and tartar.
Filling, a treatment for cavities where the dentist fills the hole in your tooth.
Extraction, when a tooth is removed.
Root canal, a treatment for an infected tooth.
Crown, a cap that covers a damaged tooth.
Braces, a device used to straighten teeth.
Dental tools, toothbrush, a tool used to clean your teeth.
Toothpaste, a cream used with a toothbrush to clean your teeth.
Floss, a thin string used to clean between your teeth.
X -ray, a picture of your teeth to check for problems.
Drill, a tool used to remove decay from a tooth.
Syringe, a tool used to give anesthesia or numbing medicine.
Symptoms and problems.
Toothache, pain in your tooth or teeth.
Cavity, a hole in a tooth caused by decay.
Gum disease, when your gums are inflamed or infected.
Sensitive teeth, teeth that hurt when eating hot or cold food.
Bleeding gums, gums that bleed when brushing or flossing.
These are some important words to help you understand what is happening at the dentist's office.

By learning these phrases, you will feel more comfortable when visiting the dentist.
